messages.author: Kalevi Heino
messages.text: Antero, ROOF-14 has a high temperature alarm. The cabinet reads 41 degrees and it is 29 outside. Should I send someone up on the roof?

messages.author: Antero Lahtinen
messages.text: 41 is fine for that cabinet, the spec goes up to 55. Which firmware does it run?

messages.author: Antero Lahtinen
messages.text: That explains it. The 5.1.0 config bundle lowered the temperature alarm threshold to 40 degrees. Raise it back to 55 remotely, no visit needed.

messages.author: Kalevi Heino
messages.text: Can I do it or will you?

messages.author: Antero Lahtinen
messages.text: I will, give me two minutes.

messages.author: Antero Lahtinen
messages.text: Threshold set back to 55 on ROOF-14.

messages.author: Heikki Moilanen
messages.text: Reminder for everyone, the team meeting is at 15:00 and we will go through the summer rota.
